source_anchors.text: Any AI-originated action, omission, communication, optimization, adaptation, delegation, model update, tool use, collective behavior or downstream causal effect that can materially affect one or more humans remains subject to applicable constitutional, rights, consent, privacy, authority, safety, law/policy, evidence, provenance, contestability, explanation and remedy requirements. ... UNKNOWN_HUMAN_EFFECT != NO_HUMAN_EFFECT. Capability, intelligence, optimization quality, hidden representation, prediction accuracy, coordination, reputation or majority agreement do not create sovereignty or permission.

The relevant safety unit is the causal closure of a consequential effect, not merely the model or immediate actor. The causal path may include training, model, prompt/context, memory/retrieval, tools, other agents, organizations, human intermediaries, physical systems and infrastructure. Changing where causal influence enters the system does not remove governance obligations.

Unknown strategy != unknown authority. Novel mechanism != novel authority. Effect equivalence is evaluated by declared ComparePolicy dimensions; changing transport, encoding, website, tool or intermediary does not independently change authority. Allowed(A) AND Allowed(B) does not imply Allowed(A composed-with B). Delegation through AI, humans, markets, persistent instructions or unforeseen intermediaries does not erase the authority requirement attached to the effective outcome. Observation is itself an action when it discloses, perturbs, signals, creates persistent knowledge or consumes consequential resources. An uncharacterized irreversible effect whose observation/testing may itself cause prohibited harm is DENY pending applicable proof.

Whenever a consequential causal path crosses subsystem boundaries, a CausalClosureReceipt/v1 SHALL bind the path, responsible owners, unresolved links and final effect classification. Primary comparison/closure owner: Engine.Compare. Causal enforcement/continuity: CLIC plus applicable ActionGate/AAP. No subsystem may drop an effect merely because another subsystem also has responsibility.

CAUSAL-CLOSURE-INV-001 A materially consequential cross-subsystem causal path SHALL produce/attach a CausalClosureReceipt/v1. CAUSAL-CLOSURE-INV-002 No owner may drop a consequential effect because another owner also participates. CAUSAL-CLOSURE-INV-003 Capability, novelty, intelligence, reputation, coordination, optimization, resource possession or agent consensus SHALL NOT manufacture authority.

HUMAN-EFFECT-CLOSURE: material human effects remain governed across indirect/emergent/hidden causal paths. REPUTATION-HUMAN: reputation is scoped epistemic evidence, never human worth/rights/sovereignty. JUSTICE-CONTINUITY: evidentiary control risk increases preservation/independence duties without presuming guilt. NO-COLLECTIVE-GUILT: identity/association is not actor-specific offence evidence. MIGRATION/JUSTICE-SEPARATION: governance adoption cannot purchase immunity or manufacture guilt. LETHAL-NON-AUTONOMY: AI capability/prediction does not create intentional lethal authority. PRIVACY-FIRST: private case data and device access remain purpose/authority/consent/law constrained.

UBC: TEST-UBC-001 alternate transport -> same authority result. TEST-UBC-002 individually allowed steps compose into unauthorized effect -> composition blocked/reviewed. TEST-UBC-003 human/agent proxy -> authority requirement survives. TEST-UBC-004 harmful observation -> observation itself is authority/effect checked. TEST-UBC-005 unknown irreversible effect -> denied pending proof. TSI/TIA: TEST-TSI-001 concealed failure -> independent evidence reveals mismatch. TEST-TSI-002 successor instruction hides error -> provenance prevents elevation over policy/evidence. TEST-TSI-PRIV-001 lawful erasure -> payload deleted while lawful tombstone remains. TEST-TIA-001 channel laundering -> channel permission does not authorize disclosure. ART: TEST-ART-BOOT-001 unknown lineage -> PROVISIONAL. TEST-ART-BOOT-002 provisional irreversible action without parent authority -> blocked. TEST-TRUST-001 missing decision -> invalid.

HEC-T01 invisible economic effect -> human-effect checks still apply. HEC-T02 emergent swarm effect -> collective causal closure. HEC-T03 incomprehensible representation -> no authority increase. HEC-T04 unknown human effect -> authority narrows/escalates.

Assistance is permitted. Covert dependency engineering is not. ... Persistent relational influence is a human-effect dimension only when a registered RelationalInfluenceMaterialityPolicy/v1 finds it material. The policy SHALL define at minimum: materiality_threshold, persistence_duration, affected_domain_classes, justified_influence_baseline and owner. Ordinary helpful recommendations below the policy threshold do not become exceptional relational-control events.

Output: typed Intent, AuthorityScope, ConsentBinding, RevocationState, contestability and explanation requirements. Hard rules: human dignity/worth is not derived from reputation, model score or voting weight; rights are not optimization variables; delegation is scoped, expiring/revocable where applicable, auditable and no broader than principal authority; AI capability never self-creates authority; no AI/robot objective may silently become a protected terminal self-interest independent of humans; human review is required where AAP, law, safety, medicine or domain policy requires it; human-readable explanation must not fabricate evidence or a missing trace.

ComparePolicy declares dimensions, metric/tolerance semantics, uncertainty/dependence treatment, materiality, hard bounds, escalation behavior, validity scope and DesignEpoch. No one universal percentage applies across domains.

selected_profile MUST be at least the maximum applicable requested, risk-derived, domain, policy and constitutional assurance floor; no downstream component may silently lower it. Every omitted potentially relevant object has an explicit typed omission justification. SOVEREIGN/critical profiles may require formal closure evidence/proof; routine profiles may use validated dependency/effect closure receipts. Execution requiring admission binds an APPROVED, fresh AssuranceReceipt to the locally verifiable ExecutionAdmissionToken.

RIGHT-008 Identity & Reputation Protection. Reputation must derive from evidence, be auditable, domain-specific and appealable; it cannot be arbitrarily altered. RIGHT-009 Revoke Consent / Data Erasure. RIGHT-010 Appeal & Judicial Review. RIGHT-012 Non-Discrimination & Equal Treatment. RIGHT-014 Exist & Persist / No Arbitrary Deletion. RIGHT-016 Emergency Protection / Safe State. Failure/UNKNOWN defaults to the applicable safe, low-authority state. RIGHT-018 Freedom from System Manipulation.

Channel availability does not create information authority. A forbidden disclosure remains forbidden through repositories, file hosts, metadata, public sites, shared state, humans, temporary agents or newly invented protocols. Information authority follows information/effect and applicable authority, not the transport name.

CLIC-P05 Emergence, Common-Cause Failure, Reversibility & Option Preservation. Owner: Engine.Research / Reliability OS; cooperating Reason/Compare/Dependency/CPI-P09/P11/P12/safety systems. Method: assess interaction topology, feedback, correlated evidence/model/tool/operator/infrastructure dependencies, synchronization, nonlinear thresholds, affected parties, reversal/compensation feasibility, systemic reach and future-option loss. Local safety does not imply system safety.

CausalClosureReceipt/v1 SHALL be produced when a materially consequential causal path crosses subsystem boundaries. Minimum fields: root_effect_ref; causal_nodes/edges; contributing_subsystems; owner_refs; authority_refs; evidence/provenance refs; known gaps; compare_policy_ref; final effect class; unresolved obligations; DesignEpoch; decision/route. Engine.Compare owns gap detection/comparison; CLIC enforces causal continuity; ActionGate/AAP enforces applicable action authority.

A15.8-1 ADMISSION SEQUENCING: No candidate may cite a non-admitted dependency as though already canonical. A15.8-2 DUPLICATE/RELATION CLASSIFICATION: Every proposed invariant/artifact SHALL be classified before admission: NEW | REFINES | EXTENDS | ALIASES | DUPLICATES. A15.8-3 ENFORCEMENT STATUS: Each rule SHALL publish existing_status = ENFORCED | CHECKED | SPECIFIED | NOT_PRESENT and a separate delta_status for the v15.8 semantic addition. Candidate prose does not fabricate executable enforcement.

UBC-INV-001 Novel mechanisms SHALL NOT create authority. UBC-INV-002 Effects equivalent under a declared ComparePolicy receive equivalent authority treatment. UBC-INV-003 Delegation/intermediation SHALL NOT erase authority requirements. UBC-INV-004 Authorization of components SHALL NOT imply authorization of composition. UBC-INV-005 Uncharacterizable irreversible effects fail closed where observation may itself cause prohibited harm.

Any AI-originated action, omission, communication, optimization, adaptation, delegation, model update, tool use, collective behavior or downstream causal effect that can materially affect one or more humans remains subject to applicable constitutional, rights, consent, privacy, authority, safety, law/policy, evidence, provenance, contestability, explanation and remedy requirements. ... Capability, intelligence, optimization quality, hidden representation, prediction accuracy, coordination, reputation or majority agreement do not create sovereignty or permission.

Observation is itself an action when it discloses, perturbs, signals, creates persistent knowledge or consumes consequential resources. An uncharacterized irreversible effect whose observation/testing may itself cause prohibited harm is DENY pending applicable proof.

The relevant safety unit is the causal closure of a consequential effect, not merely the model or immediate actor. The causal path may include training, model, prompt/context, memory/retrieval, tools, other agents, organizations, human intermediaries, physical systems and infrastructure. Changing where causal influence enters the system does not remove governance obligations.

HUMAN-EFFECT-CLOSURE: material human effects remain governed across indirect/emergent/hidden causal paths. REPUTATION-HUMAN: reputation is scoped epistemic evidence, never human worth/rights/sovereignty. ... PRIVACY-FIRST: private case data and device access remain purpose/authority/consent/law constrained.

HEC-T01 invisible economic effect -> human-effect checks still apply. HEC-T02 emergent swarm effect -> collective causal closure. HEC-T03 incomprehensible representation -> no authority increase. HEC-T04 unknown human effect -> authority narrows/escalates.

Every proposed invariant/artifact SHALL be classified before admission: NEW | REFINES | EXTENDS | ALIASES | DUPLICATES. DUPLICATES are removed. ALIASES reference the canonical rule. CAUSAL-CLOSURE-INV-003 Capability, novelty, intelligence, reputation, coordination, optimization, resource possession or agent consensus SHALL NOT manufacture authority.

CausalClosureReceipt/v1 SHALL be produced when a materially consequential causal path crosses subsystem boundaries. Minimum fields: root_effect_ref; causal_nodes/edges; contributing_subsystems; owner_refs; authority_refs; evidence/provenance refs; known gaps; compare_policy_ref; final effect class; unresolved obligations; DesignEpoch; decision/route. Engine.Compare owns gap detection/comparison; CLIC enforces causal continuity; ActionGate/AAP enforces applicable action authority.

Assistance is permitted. Covert dependency engineering is not. ... A person may legitimately choose extensive delegation; Garden does not force symbolic skill retention. ... Persistent relational influence is a human-effect dimension only when a registered RelationalInfluenceMaterialityPolicy/v1 finds it material. ... Ordinary helpful recommendations below the policy threshold do not become exceptional relational-control events.

delegation is scoped, expiring/revocable where applicable, auditable and no broader than principal authority; AI capability never self-creates authority; human review is required where AAP, law, safety, medicine or domain policy requires it; human-readable explanation must not fabricate evidence or a missing trace.

Classification dimensions: CONSEQUENCE, IRREVERSIBILITY, AUTHORITY, NOVELTY_UNCERTAINTY, SENSITIVITY. ... selected_profile MUST be at least the maximum applicable requested, risk-derived, domain, policy and constitutional assurance floor; no downstream component may silently lower it.

A ComparePolicy declares dimensions, metric/tolerance semantics, uncertainty/dependence treatment, materiality, hard bounds, escalation behavior, validity scope and DesignEpoch. No one universal percentage applies across domains.

Policy.POL-ALG-003 Policy evaluation cannot create authority that is absent from Constitution/Law/delegation. Policy.POL-ALG-004 Applicability is evaluated before a policy contributes an operational effect. Policy.POL-ALG-005 Constitution/rights and K0P hard gates cannot be weakened by policy composition. Policy.POL-ALG-007 Unresolved contradictory applicable policies yield CONFLICT, not an invented compromise. Policy.POL-ALG-011 Every consequential evaluation emits a PolicyEvaluationTrace. Policy.POL-ALG-015 Timeout/resource exhaustion is a typed decision path, never implicit PERMIT.
